name: Goose
description: Run local Goose agents in Buzz.

args:
set -eu
case "${1-}" in "" | *[!0-9A-Za-z_-]*) exit 2 ;; esac
if [ -n "${GOOSE_PATH_ROOT-}" ]; then
  c=$GOOSE_PATH_ROOT/config d=$GOOSE_PATH_ROOT/data s=$GOOSE_PATH_ROOT/state a=$GOOSE_PATH_ROOT/.agents
else
  c=${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/goose d=${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/goose
  s=${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/goose a=$HOME/.agents
fi
r=${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/buzz/goose-agents/$1
mkdir -p "$r/config"
find "$r/config" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \( -type l -o -name 'permission.yaml*' \) -exec rm -f {} +
for e in "$c"/* "$c"/.[!.]*; do
  [ -e "$e" ] || continue
  case "${e##*/}" in permission.yaml | permission.yaml.*) continue ;; esac
  ln -s "$e" "$r/config/${e##*/}"
done
for p in "data:$d" "state:$s" ".agents:$a"; do
  rm -f "$r/${p%%:*}"
  [ -e "${p#*:}" ] && ln -s "${p#*:}" "$r/${p%%:*}"
done
printf '%s\n%s\n' "$r" "$c/permission.yaml"

set -eu -o pipefail; for value in "${NO_PROXY-}" "${no_proxy-}"; do printf '%s' "$value" | /usr/bin/base64 | /usr/bin/tr -d '\n'; echo; done; if [ -n "${HTTPS_PROXY-}${https_proxy-}${HTTP_PROXY-}${http_proxy-}${ALL_PROXY-}${all_proxy-}" ]; then echo proxied; else echo direct; fi
